patterns.note: A multi-column editorial grid system is used for article display, featuring a prominent, fixed-width right sidebar for 'The Latest' content that remains in view during scroll.
Distinctive use of oversized, condensed serif fonts for the masthead and major section titles, creating a strong visual hierarchy, paired with a clean sans-serif for body text and meta-information.
A high-contrast black and white base palette is consistently applied, with a single vibrant orange accent color used strategically for hero backgrounds and key visual elements to draw attention.

The primary navigation bar at the very top of the page shrinks in height and gains a solid white background as it becomes sticky on scroll, while the right-hand 'The Latest' sidebar remains fixed in the viewport.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections introduced by large, uppercase, bold serif titles, mimicking a print magazine's layout for clear content segmentation.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that dynamically reduces its height and changes its background color upon scroll, using CSS transitions for a smooth effect. A separate right-hand sidebar should be fixed to the viewport, allowing its content to remain visible while the main content area scrolls independently.

Utilize a flexible grid system to arrange diverse article cards, featuring large hero images, prominent headlines, and smaller meta-information, creating a dynamic, magazine-like reading experience. Sections are clearly delineated with large, bold typographic headers.

Employ a stark black and white color scheme as the primary palette, leveraging high contrast for readability and visual impact, with a single, saturated accent color introduced strategically for hero backgrounds or call-to-action elements to draw attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, condensed serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, legible sans-serif body text and even finer meta-information.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between major content sections, with a balanced density within article grids to present a rich content offering.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist typography used for the masthead and section titles, which, when combined with a classic editorial grid and a vibrant, singular accent color, creates an authoritative and modern magazine aesthetic that feels both established and fresh.
